name: Afterflow
description: a predictive input cheat that fixes your early clicks and makes them accurate, with customizable UI colors and a polished control panel.

terminal-enabled.name: enable terminal
terminal-enabled.description: show the terminal button in the afterflow control panel

keybinds-title.name: keybinds
keybinds-title.description: change geodes keybinding anytime for afterflow

keybind-terminal.name: control panel
keybind-terminal.description: open or close the afterflow control panel

stage-keys-title.name: stage keys
stage-keys-title.description: bind a key to a single stage and jump straight to it. empty means unbound

keybind-stage-tight.name: stage: tight
keybind-stage-tight.description: jump straight to tight (2 ticks all modes, 2 wave)

keybind-stage-quick.name: stage: quick
keybind-stage-quick.description: jump straight to quick (4 ticks all modes, 4 wave)

keybind-stage-steady.name: stage: steady
keybind-stage-steady.description: jump straight to steady (8 ticks all modes, 8 wave)

keybind-stage-flow.name: stage: flow
keybind-stage-flow.description: jump straight to flow (16 ticks all modes, 8 wave)

keybind-stage-deep.name: stage: deep
keybind-stage-deep.description: jump straight to deep (24 ticks all modes, 12 wave)

keybind-stage-wide.name: stage: wide
keybind-stage-wide.description: jump straight to wide (32 ticks all modes, 16 wave)

keybind-stage-max.name: stage: max
keybind-stage-max.description: jump straight to max (40 ticks all modes, 20 wave)

keybind-stage-raw.name: stage: raw
keybind-stage-raw.description: jump straight to raw (off, 100% raw input)

orb-buffer-enabled.name: orb buffering
orb-buffer-enabled.description: hold an early click and drop it on the orb it would have missed

orb-buffer-ticks.name: orb buffer window
orb-buffer-ticks.description: how many ticks an early click waits for an orb (60 ticks = 0.25s)

ui-primary-color.name: primary color
ui-primary-color.description: primary gradient color for the panel

ui-secondary-color.name: secondary color
ui-secondary-color.description: secondary gradient color for the panel

ui-surface-color.name: surface color
ui-surface-color.description: background color of the panel card

ui-text-color.name: text color
ui-text-color.description: color used for all panel text

ui-glow.name: glow
ui-glow.description: draw a soft accent glow behind the panel

ui-panel-scale.name: panel scale
ui-panel-scale.description: adjust the overall size of the control panel

ui-font-scale.name: font scale
ui-font-scale.description: adjust the text size in the control panel

mobile-floating-button.name: floating af button
mobile-floating-button.description: also show the draggable af button on screen. the pause menu button is always there
